summary: Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the execution of commercial agreements for its Integrated NGLs Project. Under Argentine law, this is a material fact disclosure; the US equivalent would be a Form 6-K. The project involves construction of pipelines, a processing plant, fractionation plant, storage and marine terminal with an estimated total investment of US$3 billion. Counterparties include YPF, Pluspetrol and Chevron. The filing is a routine project update, not a special situation. No deal terms are stated. Watch for construction milestones and regulatory approvals under Argentina's RIGI regime.
